verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents a run inspector for filtering errored runs and debugging them (trigger-dev-docs-43), and run handles can be used to check status and retry a run (trigger-dev-docs-27). Configurable automatic retries with backoff cover failure recovery (trigger-dev-docs-5, trigger-dev-docs-28), but nothing in the evidence shows a manual re-run resuming from the failing step rather than restarting the whole task. Missing for 10: evidence of resuming from the failing step or checkpoint, detailed log-inspection docs, a documented dashboard re-run action, independent hands-on corroboration.
